views.name: movie_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  title,
  year,
  rating,
  num_votes
FROM Movie
views.description: Normalized projection of Movie with canonical identifiers and core measures. Use this as the base movie row for joins, aggregations, and filtering (preserves MID, title, year, rating, num_votes). | Use for: list movies with attributes, filter movies by rating/year/num_votes, join movies to genres/people/countries; compute movie-level aggregates (e.g., average rating) and produce top-k by rating or votes

views.name: genre_lookup
views.description: Pass-through of Genre dimension exposing genre id and name. Use when joining or grouping by genre Name or GID. | Use for: count movies per genre, list genres, join to M_Genre to find movies in a given genre

views.name: language_lookup
views.description: Pass-through of Language dimension exposing language id and name. Use when joining or grouping by language. | Use for: movies by language, language distribution, join to M_Language

views.name: country_lookup
views.description: Pass-through of Country dimension exposing country id and name. Use when joining or grouping by country. | Use for: movies by production country, counts by country, join to M_Country

views.name: location_lookup
views.description: Pass-through of Location dimension exposing location id and name. Use when joining or grouping by filming/location name. | Use for: movies filmed in a location, location counts, join to M_Location

views.name: person_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PID,
  Name,
  Gender
FROM Person
views.description: Normalized projection of Person with PID, Name, Gender for joining to role bridges (cast/director/producer). | Use for: list people by role, gender breakdown of cast/directors/producers, join person names to movie-role associations

views.name: movie_genres
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  mg.GID,
  g.Name AS Name
FROM M_Genre mg
JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = mg.MID
JOIN Genre g ON g.GID = mg.GID
views.description: Denormalized movie-to-genre associations: one row per MID-GID with genre Name. Use to filter or aggregate movies by genre Name or GID. | Use for: count movies per genre, list movies in a genre, compute genre-level average rating when joined to Movie

views.name: movie_languages
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  ml.LAID,
  l.Name AS Name
FROM M_Language ml
JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = ml.MID
JOIN Language l ON l.LAID = ml.LAID
views.description: Denormalized movie-to-language associations: one row per MID-LAID with language Name. Use to filter or aggregate by language. | Use for: movies by language, language counts, language-level rating statistics

views.name: movie_countries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  mc.CID,
  c.Name AS Name
FROM M_Country mc
JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = mc.MID
JOIN Country c ON c.CID = mc.CID
views.description: Denormalized movie-to-country associations: one row per MID-CID with country Name. Use for country-level aggregations or filtering. | Use for: movies by production country, country counts, average rating by country

views.name: movie_locations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  ml.LID,
  l.Name AS Name
FROM M_Location ml
JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = ml.MID
JOIN Location l ON l.LID = ml.LID
views.description: Denormalized movie-to-location associations: one row per MID-LID with location Name. Use for location-based filtering and aggregation. | Use for: movies filmed in a city, counts by location, join to Movie for ratings by location

views.name: movie_cast_people
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mc.MID,
  mc.PID,
  p.Name AS Name,
  p.Gender AS Gender
FROM M_Cast mc
JOIN Person p ON p.PID = mc.PID
views.description: Denormalized cast associations with person details: one row per MID-PID with person Name and Gender. Use for actor-level queries, counts, and joins. | Use for: count cast members per movie, list movies an actor appears in, gender breakdown of cast

views.name: movie_rating_agg_by_movie
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MID,
  AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
  SUM(num_votes) AS total_votes
FROM Movie
GROUP BY MID
views.description: Pre-aggregated movie-level measures (already one row per MID) kept as an explicit AGG to standardize measure names. Useful as an input to further grouping (genre/country/person). | Use for: join movie measures to genre/person aggregations, canonical movie measures for downstream summaries

views.name: movies_ranked_by_rating
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MID,
  m.title,
  m.year,
  m.rating,
  m.num_votes,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.rating DESC, m.num_votes DESC) AS rating_rank
FROM Movie m
views.description: Per-movie rank ordered by rating then num_votes (higher better). Exposes rank so downstream queries can take top-k by filtering on rank. Use when selecting top-rated movies overall or within partitions if joined to partitioning columns. | Use for: top-k movies by rating, tie-aware ranking of movies, downstream partitioned ranks when joined to genre/country

views.name: directors_film_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  md.PID,
  COUNT(DISTINCT md.MID) AS movie_count,
  AVG(m.rating) AS avg_director_rating
FROM M_Director md
LEFT JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = md.MID
GROUP BY md.PID
views.description: Count of movies per director (one row per director PID) and average rating across their movies. Useful for director-level leaderboards and summary stats. | Use for: who are the most prolific directors, average rating of a director's films, join to Person for director names

views.name: actors_film_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mc.PID,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) AS movie_count,
  AVG(m.rating) AS avg_actor_rating
FROM M_Cast mc
LEFT JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = mc.MID
GROUP BY mc.PID
views.description: Count of movies per cast member (one row per actor PID) and average rating across their movies. Useful for actor-level summaries and leaderboards. | Use for: most prolific actors, average movie rating for an actor, join to Person for actor names

views.name: genre_movie_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mg.GID,
  g.Name AS Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mg.MID) AS movie_count,
  AVG(m.rating) AS avg_genre_rating
FROM M_Genre mg
LEFT JOIN Movie m ON m.MID = mg.MID
LEFT JOIN Genre g ON g.GID = mg.GID
GROUP BY mg.GID, g.Name
views.description: Count of movies and average rating per genre (one row per GID). Useful for genre-level comparisons and trend analyses. | Use for: rank genres by popularity, compare average ratings across genres, genre distributions
